messages:
miguel: Quick follow-up thread from the postmortem — cross-region LB/DNS retry surge yesterday. Root cause summary in the doc, this thread is for action ownership, timelines, and tracking recurrence patterns. TL;DR: client-side backoff + intermittent DNS SNI mismatch when routing to fallback region triggered tokenized retry fanout.
rachel: Thanks. Can we list concrete action items and owners here? want to make sure timelines are realistic. :eyes:
sre_jordan: I'll own the DNS rotation guardrails task. Planning: investigate TTL drift windows + add a sanity check in health probes. ETA: 2w for root-cause validation, 4w for rollout.
netops_anya: I'll pair with jordan for the health probe changes. Also volunteered to run extended synthetic probes across regions next 72h and share charts.
oncall-bot: Incident 2024-06-18-CR-LB-145 created: https://redwood.example/incidents/CR-LB-145 (assigned: netops_anya, priority: P2)
miguel: Action list I have from the postmortem (please ack or reassign):
1) Probe + telemetry: extend cross-region synthetic probes to include SNI/TLS handshake variance and per-edge DNS timing. owner=@netops_anya, due=2024-07-01
2) DNS rotation guard: add TTL sanity checks and automated slow-roll for zone updates. owner=@sre_jordan, due=2024-07-12
3) LB fallback policy change: cap concurrent retries on fallback path to avoid amplification. owner=@eng-runtime, due=2024-06-28
4) Runbook update: add clear mitigation steps for retry storms and rollout checklist. owner=@platform-ops, due=2024-06-24
5) Post-rollout monitoring: define SLO guardrails and alert thresholds to detect recurrence. owner=@rachel, due=2024-06-21
rachel: Acked items 4 and 5. I'll draft the runbook changes today and set the alert thresholds based on yesterday's telemetry.
eng-runtime: For item 3, we propose: limit fallback concurrency to 10 requests/sec per route and add exponential backoff jitter. Patch in staging by EOD Fri. snippet: ```yaml
fallback_policy:
  max_concurrent: 10
  backoff: exponential
  jitter: 0.2
```
netops_anya: Probes start now. quick command used: `curl -v --resolve lb.region-b:443:34.56.78.90 https://edge/health` — will capture handshake timings and SNI response codes, pushing results to /dashboards/retry-playback by tomorrow.
miguel: Two operational notes: (a) This is the 3rd similar event in ~90 days (see incident refs below) — recommend a cadence to review cross-region retry metrics weekly for 6 weeks. (b) We need a single ticket that tracks all remediation owners + status.
platform-ops: I'll create a parent epic and link all items. will include owners & checkpoints. ETA: today.
sre_jordan: Quick debug finding: one DNS rotation had a missing ALIAS entry for ~90s during a zone update which increases chance of fallback routing. reproducer at: `dig @8.8.8.8 lb.service.redwood +trace` shows intermittent NXDOMAIN during that window.
rachel: Good find. Can we add an automated preflight that validates zone consistency across registrars before pushing critical updates? owner=@sre_jordan (add to item 2).
sre_jordan: Yep will add.
eng-runtime: FYI staging patch for cap+backoff deployed to canary cluster 2. Observed 3x reduction in retry amplification under simulated fanout. Need prod rollout plan: canary -> 50% -> 100% over 48h, rollback on retry rate > baseline+20%.
miguel: Please add canary gates to the rollout plan in the parent epic. platform-ops, include rollback condition.
platform-ops: Added gates + rollback rules to epic: https://redwood.example/epic/CR-LB-145-epic. Everyone please add daily check-ins to the epic comments until closed.
netops_anya: Probes initial output: attaching summary (pasted): `region-a: mean handshake 35ms, region-b: mean 120ms, NXDOMAIN spikes at 2024-06-18T23:02:14Z (90s window)` — pushing full CSV to the epic.
rachel: I'm adding alert thresholds: retry_rate > 0.8% sustained for 5m and cross-region handshake variance > 100ms triggers pager P1. Will tune if too noisy.
eng-runtime: One implementation risk: capping concurrency could increase latency for some steady-state flows. We'll add a soft cap default and allow per-route overrides.
miguel: Noted. Please document tradeoffs in the PR.
oncall-bot: Reminder: weekly recurrence review scheduled: 2024-06-25 15:00 UTC — invite sent to #incidents and owners.
platform-ops: Parent epic now tracks status fields: in-progress, blocked, validated, closed. I've set daily owners to post a short update (1-2 lines) until closed.
sre_jordan: Blocker: need confirmation from registrar on update propagation guarantees. Reaching out; ETA 48h. marking item 2 status=blocked.
netops_anya: Will run longer probe window while registrar confirms. adding 7-day probe run.
miguel: Final ask before we close this thread: owners, please ack your item and confirm the single-line daily update cadence. once all acked i'll mark the postmortem follow-up as on-tracker.
miguel: @sre_jordan? @netops_anya? @eng-runtime? @platform-ops? @rachel?
sre_jordan: ack — 1–2 line update daily.
netops_anya: ack — pushing probes and CSVs daily.
eng-runtime: ack — will post deploys + canary metrics daily.
platform-ops: ack — epic owner, will nudge and summarize daily.
rachel: ack — alerts + runbook draft done, will post link when ready. :white_check_mark:
miguel: Thanks everyone. closing thread for async updates — please keep posts in the epic and drop short updates here if something blocks rollout. :pray:
